tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand blue. Primary buttons, active nav pill, links, current-page state, the website hero panel, income series in charts. White text on it is 5.6:1.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of anything filled with accent. Link hover.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Blue text on tint and tint-2 (5.4:1 or better): service chips, column counters, planned chip, dense links, step numbers.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand ink. Sidebar, footer, dark KPI tile (Laba), secondary dark buttons, expense series in charts.

tokens.name: navy-2
tokens.usage: Hover row and hover button on navy surfaces.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Highlight on navy and accent: headline accent words, chart planned series, delta chip on the dark tile. On accent only for text 24px and larger (3.6:1).

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Kanban column background, solution cards, soft chips, progress-bar track.

tokens.name: tint-2
tokens.usage: App page background behind cards, input and search fills, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, drawers, tables, header bars, modals.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card and input borders, table dividers, header bottom border. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: the upcoming-step ring, the planned-income dashed border, input focus outline base. 3.2:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on surface, tint and tint-2 (14:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, meta lines, inactive tabs. On surface, tint-2 and tint (6.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Captions and chart axis labels. On surface and tint-2 only (4.8:1); not on tint.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled arrows and controls only. Never for readable text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent, navy and every *-fill.

tokens.name: on-accent-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on accent, e.g. the greeting date line (4.7:1).

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on navy: tile labels, footer text (10:1).

tokens.name: on-dark-link
tokens.usage: Inactive sidebar links on navy (13:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Income amounts, Dibayar and Deal ✓ text, positive deltas. On surface and success-bg (5.7:1).

tokens.name: success-fill
tokens.usage: Solid success marks: done-step icon, WhatsApp button, won column accent, profit line in charts. White text on it 4.6:1.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Background of success chips, the won column and the Deal menang modal header.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Late labels, expense amounts, Batal text, negative deltas. On surface and danger-bg (6:1).

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Solid danger marks: late-step icon, sidebar count badge, top border of the Terlambat card. White text on it 5.3:1.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Background of late next-action boxes, late chips and the Batal column.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due-today text and times. On surface and warning-bg (4.8:1).

tokens.name: warning-fill
tokens.usage: Today ring on a step and the top border of the Hari ini card. Not for text.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background of due-today next-action boxes and rows.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: Everything produced by AI and only that: Saran AI labels, AI buttons, the 'Dibuat dari saran AI' chip. On ai-bg 7.6:1.

tokens.name: ai-bg
tokens.usage: Background of AI suggestion cards and the Minta saran AI button.

tokens.name: ai-chip-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the small AI origin chip on plan cards.

tokens.name: ai-line
tokens.usage: Border of the Saran AI section and AI buttons.

tokens.name: stage-lead
tokens.usage: Column dot and funnel bar for Lead.

tokens.name: stage-contacted
tokens.usage: Column dot and funnel bar for Dihubungi.

tokens.name: stage-meeting
tokens.usage: Column dot and funnel bar for Meeting / Discovery.

tokens.name: stage-proposal
tokens.usage: Column dot and funnel bar for Proposal Terkirim.

tokens.name: stage-negotiation
tokens.usage: Column dot and funnel bar for Negosiasi. The blue deepens toward closing.

tokens.name: chart-income
tokens.usage: Pemasukan series in every chart.

tokens.name: chart-expense
tokens.usage: Pengeluaran series in every chart. Paired with chart-income it differs in lightness, not hue alone.

tokens.name: chart-planned
tokens.usage: Direncanakan (planned) series, drawn hatched.

tokens.name: chart-profit
tokens.usage: Laba line when drawn over the bars.
